snippet.title: Tetris 2 (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Nintendo, Oct 1993 (Original Hardware, Composite)
snippet.description:
Tetris 2 was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in October 1993. All audio/visual elements copyright 1993, Nintendo. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/tetris-2/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT TETRIS 2 (NES)

Uses disconnected colored tetriminoes instead of adjacent type tetrominoes. It is the first Tetris to make use of the gravity algorithm. Blocks of the same color stick together. The goal of Tetris 2 is to clear the bottom rows, which a similar type of play can be found in the later released The Next Tetris or Tetris II. Released as Tetris Flash in Japan.

AKA: Tetris Flash
